page_runner.actions: actual mini-program page send and expired-code login submission

basis: The original runner's strict assertion required an error string to remain in page data and therefore reported an inconclusive failure. The preserved API log independently binds the real post-wait page submission to a 401 AUTH.INVALID_CODE response, while the preserved page observation remained on the login page. Together they establish rejection without rerunning the page or changing the 300-second TTL.
boundary: This is one isolated Development SMS test-inbox page acceptance. It is not paid SMS delivery, Production provider, abuse, device-fleet or release acceptance.
